No ambient or recovered lattice and no atomic coordinates exist for this phase in the source. The executable V0 values are spin-branch-specific EOS extrapolations, not structure models, so no lattice, space group, or atom sites are invented. The authors identify an approximately 2% volume discontinuity near 47 GPa without a qualitative diffraction-pattern change and interpret it as a spin transition.
